translations.web: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
translations.bsb: And I will constrain Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation; she will be like an altar hearth before Me.
translations.kjv: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
